body:
Welcome to SloBlock, the first Slovenian Minecraft server without pay-to-win mechanics.

Our goal is to deliver a high-quality gameplay experience with unique systems, custom content, and a strong community where both new and experienced players can explore, build, compete, and enjoy the game. ⚡

## ✨ What does SloBlock offer?
Free unlockable rank system
Custom worlds
Advanced Jobs & Skills system
Balanced economy
Virtual spawners
100+ custom enchant books
Custom armor, tools, backpacks, and items
PvP Arena and monthly events

## 🏙️ About the server
The first season was based on a steampunk theme, while the current season is focused on cyberpunk.

The server heavily focuses on:

- 🚀 progression
- 🌎 exploration
- 💸 economy
- 🏗️ building
- 🤝 community

The primary game remains Wonderland, redesigned with a more modern and futuristic atmosphere.

Whether you want to build cities, explore the unknown, or play with friends — SloBlock offers a place where players can progress and become part of an active community.
